verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents documents first-class MCP support: you wrap an MCP server in an `MCPToolset` and pass it to the agent's `tools` parameter. The GitHub README adds that tools from MCP servers integrate "with one line of code", so a single integration exposes a whole toolset to the voice agent. missing for 10: no hands-on or independent corroboration of MCP tool calls during a live call, and no documentation of attaching or swapping MCP toolsets dynamically mid-session or of supported transports and auth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call

citations.quote: LiveKit Agents has first-class support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Wrap an MCP server in an `MCPToolset` and pass it to the agent's `tools` parameter
Native support for MCP. Integrate tools provided by MCP servers with one line of code.
